Oobe.Title: Mofumofu Launcher
Oobe.Subtitle: First launch — a few quick settings before we start
Oobe.WelcomeBody: Choose your language and theme. Both can be changed later in Settings.
Oobe.DirectoryBody: Pick your Minecraft .minecraft folder. Leave blank to use the launcher folder; it will be created automatically.
Oobe.JavaBody: The launcher finds a suitable Java automatically; you can also pick a default runtime.
Oobe.JavaLater: No suitable Java yet? Install Zulu / Temurin / Oracle later under Download → Java.
Oobe.JavaNone: No Java detected. You can install one later under Download → Java.
Oobe.AccountBody: Create an offline account now, or sign in with a Microsoft account later on the Accounts page.
Oobe.FinishBody: Review the settings below and click Finish to start.
Oobe.Account.MicrosoftHint: Sign in through the browser; the account is saved automatically.
Oobe.Account.AuthlibHint: Enter the skin server Yggdrasil API URL, username and password; the profile is saved after sign-in.
Oobe.Account.AuthlibRequired: Enter server URL, username and password
Oobe.Account.AuthlibNoProfile: This account has no available profile
Oobe.Account.WaitingBrowser: Complete Microsoft sign-in in the browser…
